title: The most powerful weapon you wield isn't a sword. It's a surrendered heart. 🔥 It's in our deepest humility that God's greatest strength is revealed.
paragraphs: The most powerful weapon you wield isn't a sword. It's a surrendered heart. 🔥 It's in our deepest humility that God's greatest strength is revealed.
When you stop fighting your way and start surrendering to His, the real battle is already won.
📖 "But He said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.'" - 2 Corinthians 12:9
Drop an "AMEN" below if you are surrendering your battles to Him today! 👇👇👇
